The '''Assembly Watcher WX''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] and used to oversee the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
